description: Common type definitions used across all Hypercerts protocols.

descriptionString.description: An inline long-form description as plain text or markdown, with optional rich-text annotations.

value.description: The description text (plain text or markdown).

facets.description: Rich text annotations for the description (mentions, URLs, hashtags, etc).

uri.description: Object containing a URI to external data

smallBlob.description: Object containing a blob to external data

largeBlob.description: Object containing a blob to external data

instant.description: A timestamp identifying an instant with a known UTC offset. Do not use an unknown offset (-00:00) or infer an offset from the viewer timezone.

value.description: ATProto datetime with a known UTC offset, for example 2019-07-14T13:22:05+12:00.

localDateTime.description: A Gregorian local date and time whose UTC offset is unknown. This value does not identify an instant.

value.description: Valid Gregorian YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, optionally followed by a decimal point and 1 to 9 fractional-second digits. No UTC offset or Z suffix. Clients must validate calendar and clock values; Lexicon enforces only string length.

calendarDate.description: A Gregorian calendar date with no known time of day or UTC offset. This value does not identify an instant.

value.description: Valid Gregorian date in YYYY-MM-DD form. Do not interpret as midnight UTC. Clients must validate calendar values; Lexicon enforces only string length.
